items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: We had Buster Wilson on piano. Mmhmm. Buster Scott on guitar. I was on the bass.

ctx.x: Well that was Philip Kaiko was his brother. Cripple Pill. You remember Cripple Pill? I think he played banjo. No clarinet play. Yeah that was his brother and he was Kaiko. Yeah? Yeah. But I don't know and that's what Billy Moran's son, Lawrence Marrero used to call him Kaiko. Yeah. Did he ever play with Jelly Roll? Would you know? Who? Ernest Johnson. You wouldn't know maybe. Ernest was playing with the Black and Tanned. I don't think so now. Oh yeah. And what about Jelly Roll's band that he put up you know after…

Yeah. Yeah. We was gonna have an awful band. We had about ten or twelve of us. Let's see. Let's see. Let's see. I start the name. We had Buster Wilson on piano. Mmhmm. Buster Scott on guitar. I was on the bass. We had a... We had a... Mutt on trumpet. We had an Orion trombone. Mmhmm. Mmhmm.
